svg.title: From a URL to a rendered page, with address changes
svg.desc: Six lifelines show the computer, NAT gateway, Internet routing path, DNS resolver, DNS authorities, and web server. ARP, DNS, TCP, TLS, HTTP, rendering, and later requests are annotated with IP addresses, ports, and per-hop MAC addresses.

text.tspan: 1. Look up the route for the external DNS query

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: ARP travels directly in Ethernet, no TCP/UDP ports

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 2. DNS: query the A record for shop.example.com

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: Ordinary forwarding preserves IP addresses and ports

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: Each router encapsulates for its outgoing link

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: The Ethernet destination MAC identifies the next hop

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: New DNS queries use the resolver's own IP and temporary ports

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 3. TCP three-way handshake: connect to the website on port 443

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 4. TLS / HTTP arrows below are logical end-to-end exchanges, traffic still crosses G and N

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: Outbound: C → GL, GW → I, intermediate hops, RS → S

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: Return: S → RS, intermediate hops, I → GW, GL → C

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: The same TCP ports and NAT mapping remain in use

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: Outer IP addresses and TCP ports still identify routing and connections

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 5. HTTP/2: request the product page after connection initialization

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: is not sent in the HTTP request

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: Larger responses span TCP segments, TCP handles acknowledgments, ordering, and retransmission

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: Segments still travel as IP packets, link frames, and signals, HTTP/2 frame boundaries need not align

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
text.tspan: 6. HTML reveals more resources, reuse the same TCP / TLS connection

text.style: font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
font-family: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400;
